name: builder-os
description: BuilderOS — the operating system for product builders. Eight gated phases from an idea to a product in production, with source-tagged evidence and zero prerequisites.

interface.shortDescription: Gated lifecycle from idea to production for product builders
interface.longDescription: Use BuilderOS to take an idea or a problem through framing, discovery, definition, ideation, spec, build, release and outcome review, with a gate between every phase and a source tag on every claim. Works with nothing connected.
defaultPrompt: I have an idea and want to know if it is worth building.
We want to add a feature to our product.
